en: Whew.
I think I've made it to the depths of the forest....
Whew. I'm feeling a bit worn out.
All right. The miasma seems light in this room.
Just what I needed! Let me rest for a while.
Holy..!  Who's there?
Hi, young lady.  Kukkukku.  Doing well?
What, do you need something?
My goodness, how unfriendly.  And after I took all this trouble to bring you information.
Information? What is it?
Perhaps it is closer to gossip than information, but...
Lose the pompous act and spit it out already!
Dear me, so impatient.
It seems that in order to rescue the professor, the power of genomroid is required.
Without it, even if you find the professor, you won't be able to free him.
Genomroid?!
Yes.  That's what I overheard just now at any rate.
As I recall, that word was mentioned in Father's diary too, wasn't it.
I see.  I'm afraid I could not say what a genomroid is, however...
You're right.  I will.  Thank you!
Kukkukku...  I'm so pleased to have been helpful.
Farewell.
Genomroid...  I wonder what that actually is?
Mikhail might know something about it!
All right.  Let's try asking him.
